explication: MangoDisk is a cross-platform desktop utility for storage cleanup and analysis, privacy protection, and system management. Its main workflow is to choose scan locations, inspect read-only findings, review proposed changes, confirm actions, and retain an operation record. The README documents broad capabilities; the tree shows corresponding Rust core, platform, command, and frontend modules. Sampled source provides detail on storage preferences and cleanup safety, but not the full UI-to-command wiring, so links between those layers are shown only at the documented feature level.
